integrity: Explicit all-parameter rank-one proof and exact-rational direct Laplacian checking code are included; finite verification corroborates rather than replaces the proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to Euclidean-orthogonal cut and cycle projectors on real edge coordinates of unweighted K_{m,n} plus an intrapart edge. No optimality among arbitrary projections, and no claim about weighted graphs, multiple inserted edges, or other families. Independent mathematical validation not performed.
title: A five-zone edge-insertion law for endpoint cut–cycle projection norms of bicliques
